messages.subject: Invoice does not match confirmed price
messages.body:
We just received the invoice for our rental and the amount is higher than what was shown when the booking was confirmed. The price at confirmation is supposed to be the price we pay, that is what your own rental terms say. So how has the invoice ended up with a different number?

We have been renting from you since 2021 and this has never happened before. Please correct the invoice to match the confirmed booking price.

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy

messages.subject: Re: Invoice does not match confirmed price
messages.body:
Thank you for flagging this. I have passed it to our invoicing team so they can compare the booking confirmation against the invoice. We will be in touch once we have had a chance to look into it.

Hanna-Kaisa Louhi
Rental Coordinator, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Invoice does not match confirmed price
messages.body:
Separate question while we wait on the invoice thing. Do you have a 6m scaffold tower available? We need one for an upcoming job.

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy
